Headline: Everything is working
Sub: All services responded to their last check.

Groups.Title: On the web
Groups.Note: What you use in a browser or on your phone.

Services.Name: Accounts
Services.Blurb: Creating an account, signing in, and everything that needs your identity.

Services.Name: Cloud saves
Services.Blurb: Backing up and restoring game saves from an emulator or the website.

Services.Name: Console link page
Services.Blurb: The page your phone opens when you link a console.

Services.Name: Game achievements
Services.Blurb: The trophies and achievements every console earns, kept in one place across consoles.

Services.Name: Game leaderboards
Services.Blurb: The shared score boards every console's games post to and read from.

Services.Name: Game title storage
Services.Blurb: The shared place where every console's games keep each player's own data, like progress counters and uploads.

Services.Name: Messages
Services.Blurb: Messages between friends on the website, the phone app and Miiverse.

Services.Name: Website
Services.Blurb: The site itself: signing in, your friends, your account.

Groups.Title: On a console
Groups.Note: What your Switch talks to. These are checked the way a console reaches them, not the way a browser would.

Services.Name: Account service
Services.Blurb: How a console proves who you are. Sign-in and friends on the console depend on it.

Services.Name: Device auth
Services.Blurb: The first thing a console does. If this is down, no console can reach the network at all.

Services.Name: Licence service
Services.Blurb: Checked while a console adds an account. If it fails, adding an account stops part-way.

Services.Name: Risk of Rain Returns secure port
Sign-in page
Services.Blurb: The sign-in screen a console shows while linking an account.

Groups.Title: On an Xbox 360
Groups.Note: Xbox Live services an Xbox 360 reaches through the OpenPak gateway.

Groups.Title: On a PS3
Groups.Note: PlayStation Network services a PS3 reaches, checked by the console's own host names.

Services.Name: Friends
Services.Blurb: Your PS3 friends list.

Services.Name: Game update checks
Services.Blurb: Checking for game updates when a PS3 game starts.

Services.Name: Leaderboards
Services.Blurb: Posting scores and reading leaderboards in PS3 games.

Services.Name: Message attachments
Services.Blurb: Files attached to PS3 messages between friends.

Services.Name: Online save storage
Services.Blurb: Keeping PS3 game saves on the network.

Services.Name: Presence
Services.Blurb: Seeing which PS3 friends are online and what they are playing.

Services.Name: Profiles
Services.Blurb: Your name and avatar as other PS3 players see them.

Services.Name: Sign-in
Services.Blurb: Signing a PS3 in to the network.

Services.Name: Title User Storage
Services.Blurb: Data a PS3 game keeps on the network for each player.

Services.Name: Trophies
Services.Blurb: Syncing and viewing PS3 trophies.

Services.Name: XMB feeds
Services.Blurb: What's New and the game and video billboards on the PS3 home screen.

Groups.Title: On a PS4
Groups.Note: PlayStation Network services a PS4 reaches, checked by the console's own host names.

Services.Name: System update checks
Services.Blurb: Checking for system software updates when a PS4 starts. OpenPak answers that nothing is newer, so consoles stay on their current firmware.

Groups.Title: On an original Xbox
Groups.Note: Sign-in, friends, accounts and voice for the original Xbox, checked from the status host.
